mapper.insert: INSERT INTO registration_verification_token (user_id, token_hash, expires_at, requested_ip) VALUES (#{userId}, #{tokenHash}, DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL #{expiryMinutes} MINUTE), #{requestedIp})
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM registration_verification_token WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash} AND consumed_at IS NULL AND expires_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP() )
mapper.update: UPDATE registration_verification_token SET exchanged_at = COALESCE(exchanged_at, UTC_TIMESTAMP()), exchange_session_hash = COALESCE(exchange_session_hash, #{exchangeSessionHash}) WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash} AND (exchanged_at IS NULL OR exchange_session_hash = #{exchangeSessionHash}) AND consumed_at IS NULL AND expires_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP()
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM registration_verification_token WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash} AND exchanged_at IS NOT NULL AND consumed_at IS NULL AND expires_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP() )

SELECT id, user_id, token_hash, expires_at, exchanged_at, consumed_at, requested_ip, created_at FROM registration_verification_token WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash} AND exchanged_at IS NOT NULL AND consumed_at IS NULL AND expires_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP()
mapper.update: UPDATE registration_verification_token SET consumed_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP() WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash} AND exchanged_at IS NOT NULL AND consumed_at IS NULL AND expires_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP()
UPDATE registration_verification_token SET consumed_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND consumed_at IS NULL
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM registration_verification_token WHERE expires_at < UTC_TIMESTAMP() OR consumed_at IS NOT NULL
